description: Consolidate three monthly surveillance CSV files (Surv_Jan.csv, Surv_Feb.csv, Surv_Mar.csv) into a single master dataset 'Q1_Confirmed.csv' using Epi Info 7 Classic Analysis. You must READ each file, SELECT only records where Classification is 'Confirmed', and WRITE them to the master file (using Append for subsequent files). Finally, generate a frequency report of the 'Disease' variable from the consolidated file and save it as 'Q1_Summary.html'. The source files are located in 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\Data\'.
